presets.label: Benefits from succeeding
presets.query: text ?? ["if you succeed,", "if you succeed and", "if this test succeeds", "is successful,", "is successful while", "is successful during", "successfully evade"]

presets.label: Benefits from succeeding, no Succeed By
presets.query: text ? ["if you succeed", "if this test succeeds", "is successful", "successfully evade"] & text !? ["succeed by", "successful by"]
